messages.subject: Overlaying barplot with 2 axes
parts:
Hi!
I'm wondering if this type of graph is even possible to create? I was
thinking somehow with the twoord.plot() in the plotrix package.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Overlaying barplot with 2 axes
parts:
If you mean "possible to create using ggplot" the basic answer is no,
not really. (This gets philosophical and has been debated here many
times.) Yes it can be faked, but if you really need a plot with
multiple y axes, it's probably best to explore other options.

Ben
